claims.claim: Most children start Reception in September after their fourth birthday
claims.quote: Most children start reception full-time in September after their fourth birthday.
claims.note: The school admissions page states this usual starting point.

claims.claim: Full-time education becomes compulsory after the child’s fifth birthday
claims.quote: If your child’s fifth birthday is on one of those dates then they reach compulsory school age on that date.
claims.note: The usual compulsory-age date follows the fifth birthday, but a birthday on 31 December, 31 March or 31 August makes it compulsory on that birthday.
